Retain prestress and geometric terms in T-transpose H T plus the coordinate-map curvature contribution
Use series compliance or parallel stiffness averaging only for justified load sharing; ratios of medians are not homogenization
Retain joint molecular orientation and geometry distributions and propagate mapping uncertainty
Audit local network excursions against the fit window; explicitly label extrapolation
